title: Monotonicity of the upper bound
statement: Let $\mu:\mathbb N\to\mathbb Z$, and suppose a list $l$ of length $N$ records the values of $\mu$ at the consecutive indices starting at $a$, with $a+N\le\mathrm{top}$. For any $\mathrm{top}'$ with $\mathrm{top}\le\mathrm{top}'$, the same list records the same segment and satisfies $a+N\le\mathrm{top}'$.
hypotheses_covered: l records μ on the segment starting at a
